name: yuva
description: Your Yuva support inbox in Claude: search, read, triage and draft replies.
long_description: Connects to a Yuva server's MCP endpoint with an API key. The assistant can search and read conversations, contacts and feedback, and draft replies, notes, labels and assignments within the key's scopes and inboxes. Replies stay drafts for a member to send unless the workspace lets bots send.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Your Yuva server, for example https://support.example.com

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: A Yuva API key (Settings > API keys); its scopes and inboxes limit what the assistant can do.
